subject: *: add SET INSTANCE syntax (#63484)
summary: Reviewed commit 12bbfbcc94a7 relative to first parent 19e01029d393, focusing on executor/expression/parser/planner changes enabling `SET INSTANCE` and `@@instance.`. Parser correctly tags instance scope via new `IsInstance` flags on `ast.VariableExpr`/`ast.VariableAssignment`; planner enforces global-like privileges for instance assignments and propagates the flag into `expression.VarAssignment`; executor and expression rewriter both gate `INSTANCE` scope to sysvars with `HasInstanceScope()` and otherwise raise incorrect-scope errors, while treating instance reads/writes via the existing global-sysvar access path. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/privilege/session behavior for the touched areas, and later history up to `upstream/master` contains follow-up adjustments (e.g. #63615) but no unresolved Blocker/High issues attributable to this commit.
